paragraphs.source_en: Meitei took up Suzuki's words and said, "Because you know nothing about it, you sit there coolly saying, 'Surely it cannot be so,' unusually quiet and pretending to be refined. Did you not do battle with Nose that time?"

paragraphs.source_en: Since Meitei's banter had at last carried the talk away from the Kaneda affair, Suzuki felt relieved, breathed a long sigh, and said, "As always, it is a pleasure to have everyone chatter away so freely! Meeting you all again after a full ten years, I feel as though I have suddenly come out of a narrow alley into a broad open field. When people in our circle talk, one has to be exceedingly careful; one cannot let one's guard down for an instant. Whatever one says, one must be on the watch; it is anxious, tense, and truly oppressive. How pleasant it is when talk is as easy and innocent as it was just now. It is wonderful to chat with old classmates from one's student days, without the least need for ceremony. Ah, ah, I never expected to meet you today, Meitei; it has been delightful. I have a little business to attend to, so I shall excuse myself." When Suzuki had said this, Meitei also said, "I shall go too. I have to go on to the Society for the Reform of the Performing Arts in Nihonbashi, so I shall accompany you that far." Suzuki said, "That is splendid. Since it is such a rare chance, let us take a walk together."

paragraphs.source_zh: 经迷亭这么一段闲谈才离开了金田事件，铃木君这才放下心来，长出一口气，说道：“还是老样子，大家随便地扯上一扯，真痛快！足足经过十年才又见到你们，就感到好像从一条窄胡同里一下子走到旷野里来似的。要是我们那伙人谈话，那就得小心翼翼，一点大意不得呀。不管说什么总得留神，又操心又紧张，真是苦恼极啦。方才的谈话轻松自在，该多好。和过去学生时期的老同学聊聊，根本用不着客气，真好哇。啊、啊，今天想不到会遇上迷亭君，真愉快，我还有点事儿，失陪啦。”铃木君说完，迷亭也说道：“我也走，我回头还要到日本桥的‘演艺矫风会’去，我陪你一起走吧。”铃木君说：“那太好啦，难得一次机会，咱们一起散散步吧。”
